versions.changelog:
Initial release of Claw To Talk skill:

- Introduces the official push-to-talk mobile companion app for OpenClaw (iOS & Android).
- Provides detailed setup instructions integrating Tailscale and optional ElevenLabs TTS.
- Outlines common troubleshooting steps for connectivity and audio quality.
- Adds guidance for connecting, approving devices, and enhancing voice with ElevenLabs.
- Directs users to the official website for the latest updates and step-by-step guides.
